title: Lead quality mismatch
text: High-severity lead quality mismatch (Meta Ads): lead volume jumped +39.4% (69 vs 49.5) while paid conversions were nearly flat (+4.3%, 8 vs 7.67). Spend also rose +7.1% ($980 vs $914.67), so cost efficiency is deteriorating (lead→paid rate ~11.6%) without a corresponding lift in paid outcomes/MRR. Check next: break out lead→paid by Meta campaign/ad set/creative, verify targeting + offer/landing-page fit, and inspect where drop-off increased between landing → signup/activation → payment.
